reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the supplied needs and assigns direct coverage only when a capability has the exact same need text; records without matching capabilities remain unsupported. This matches the supplied input/output handoff shape and does not introduce unrelated candidates.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported to true when coverage is direct. The assigned output therefore prioritizes covered capabilities as if they were unsupported, while actual unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07 are pushed to the bottom and marked unsupported false. This is behaviorally significant because the market-demand review must keep missing or unsupported evidence visible rather than treating covered keyword matches as gaps.

synthesize_recommendation deterministically reports the first retained priority, but its recommendation depends on the corrupted unsupported flag and ordering produced upstream by prioritize_needs. The local function is not independently shown to be defective, yet its final claim inherits contradictory evidence about which needs are actually unsupported.
